description:
IAPWS R7-97(2012), 'Revised Release on the IAPWS Industrial Formulation 1997', carries per-region verification tables. Free PDF from iapws.org.

Every downstream V&V case (turbine efficiency, pipe pressure drop, void fraction) is meaningless if h(p,s) or the (p,h) flash is wrong, so this is the prerequisite gate. bubble_point_saturation_validation.rs covers the saturation line but NOT the region-by-region tables.

First step is an audit: check what region coverage already exists before writing new tests.

Scope context: crates/tampines-steam-tables/docs/validation-scope-turbine-and-pipe.md section 5.
title: V&V: IAPWS-IF97 region verification tables (R7-97) as the property-layer gate

acceptance_criteria: Written derivation of KNP deferred-correction flux + beta(Ma) min-gating + static-enthalpy choice, ready for paper methods.
description: By-hand analytical derivation of the Mach-weighted KNP dissipation that removed the near-sonic ringing (op-21g.15). Author's own derivation for the paper methods (Phase II row B of the Edwards debug timeline table, index.tex). Derive: (1) the KNP (Kurganov-Noelle-Petrova) central-upwind numerical flux and its local wave speeds built from the HEM equilibrium sound speed, and how it enters PIMPLE as a deferred-correction flux; (2) the Mach-weight blending function beta(Ma) and the justification for gating on min(Ma) of the two adjacent cells rather than max(Ma) -- at a liquid/two-phase interface the liquid ~1400 m/s sound speed makes the KNP viscosity huge, but that wave is genuinely low-Mach and must not be dissipated, so min(Ma) activates KNP only where both sides are near-sonic; (3) why dissipation must act on static enthalpy rho*he, not total energy rho*E (carrying rho*E re-injects the -p pressure-work term and over-cools through 273.15K).
title: Derive by hand: HybridAllMach KNP central-upwind dissipation blending (for paper methods)
